summary: Codex hosted web search works on the S24: new pinned set codex-android-compat (fs-safe temp workspace trusts Android's platform-owned, group-writable ancestors; model/list cap 5 s -> 20 s; explicit search model by OPENCLAW_CODEX_WEB_SEARCH_MODEL) plus the codex-termux.sh launcher that gives the musl Codex binary Termux DNS and CA bundle through proot. gateway-start.sh exports the launcher and gpt-5.6-luna only after the set is applied and verified; runtime-sync checks and applies it; deploy rollback undoes it.
reason: Since tools.web.search.provider=codex (03/11 12:09), every native web search on the S24 failed (live check 19:14: 'La recherche web a échoué côté fournisseur'). Four causes found in order on the S24: fs-safe rejects /data (uid 1000, mode 0771) as temp ancestor; then /data/data/com.termux/files (0771); then model/list exceeds the hard-coded 5 s; then the musl Codex binary cannot resolve DNS (no /etc/resolv.conf on Android): 'Reconnecting... workspace routing discovery failed'. With all four fixed, a hosted search turn takes about 6 s and the provider 14-20 s end to end.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-codex-android-compat.py
tests.evidence: 10 tests: pinned originals equal the S24 modules; apply/check/re-apply/rollback exact across the openclaw and codex roots; single codex package discovered, ambiguity refused; unknown hash or version refused before any write; real classifyTempWorkspaceOwner trusts uid 1000 only with an Android environment; node --check of every patched module; private leaf stays strict and unset variables keep shipped search; exports only after a verified apply; sync/deploy wiring; launcher binds Termux resolv.conf through proot and passes arguments; set disjoint from the other sets. Registered in ci.yml.

tests.name: S24 manual equivalent (03/11, before this PR)
tests.evidence: Same four changes applied by hand with backups, then openclaw infer web search --provider codex: gpt-6-luna 13.6 s (wrong answer), gpt-5.6-luna 16.6 s, gpt-6-astra 17.3 s, gpt-6.1-sol 20.4 s (provider tookMs, same question, correct answers sourced).

capabilities.reason: Compatibility set, launcher, startup wiring and tests; no route, action or capability (NO_CAPABILITY). The native web_search tool keeps its contract.

architecture.reason: Same patch owner, manifest format and ownership pattern as the other pinned sets; the owner learns a second plugin root like the WhatsApp one. No new store, scheduler or daemon.

evidence: Gateway start environment, OpenClaw/Codex plugin modules and a launcher; no MCP tool or schema touched.

limitations: The S24 currently carries the hand-applied equivalent; activation restores the saved originals, then the owner applies this set and the Gateway restarts once.
One measurement per model on 03/11; the model choice (gpt-5.6-luna) is exported with an override and can be revisited.
Each search still starts a fresh Codex app-server (8-14 s of the total on the phone); a warm app-server is out of scope.
The app capability samantha.app.web.* (parallel-free) is unchanged here; Codex-first with Parallel fallback there is a follow-up.
rollback: Revert this commit: runtime-sync and deploy rollback undo the set and the launcher is no longer exported; by hand, --patch-set codex-android-compat --rollback then restart through the Gateway owner.
